evidence.observation: O2 1.7 ppm at start of growth, after purge brought it down to about 2 ppm
O2 has risen steadily to 25.3 ppm during growth, more than 10 times the baseline
Ar flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the rise is not from reduced purge flow
Thermocouple steady at about 750 C and heater power stable at about 44%
Pressure gauge not installed, so the tube atmosphere and pressure cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading, or a leak check or exhaust-line inspection, to tell a seal leak (air getting in) from an exhaust blockage (backflow). No sample characterization yet.
